newsitem.title: CANADA: Methanex stock down on Q4 earnings charge.
newsitem.headline: Methanex stock down on Q4 earnings charge.

text.p: Methanex Corp shares fell on Monday after the methanol producer said it would take a US$100 million charge in the fourth quarter to cover production cutbacks at its high-cost plants.
Methanex stock fell 0.45 to 13.30 on turnover of about 547,000 shares in Toronto.
Methanex said it would reduce production at Medicine Hat, Alberta and idle its Waitara facility in New Zealand as its new lower cost plants in Chile came on stream.
Analysts said the company's exact plans remained unclear and expected more details in a conference call later. Methanex officials were not immediately available for comment.
But Methanex has long said it would consider using its new low cost plants in Chile to replace production from higher cost facilities.

"There's nothing surprising here to me. They have confirmed what they said they would do," said Oppenheimer analyst Jeff Spetalnick. He said he was unworried by the earnings charge since it reflected an asset writedown and as such was accounting move rather than a cash loss from operations.
